author: KEXP
description:
Phoenix four-piece Glixen transcend in the shoegaze renaissance. In our latest Live on KEXP session, the band create a heavy sonic experience with a performance of "Medicine Bow" and more. 

Watch the full listener-powered in-studio session at the link in our bio.
title: Glixen - Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
